user.title: Add Twinkly lights
user.description: Enter the IP address or host name of your Twinkly lights.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the lights on your network.

reconfigure.title: Change the host
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address or host name of these Twinkly lights.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the lights on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Twinkly device at this host. Check the address and that the lights are powered on.

abort.already_configured: These lights are already set up.
abort.unsupported_device: These lights are not supported: they need firmware 2.5.6 or newer and RGB or RGBW LEDs.
abort.compatibility_mode_off: Compatibility mode is turned off on these lights. Turn it on in the Twinkly app and try again.
abort.core_twinkly_configured: These lights are already set up with Home Assistant's built-in Twinkly integration. Both integrations would keep logging each other out of the lights, so remove the built-in Twinkly entry first.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This host belongs to a different device than the one you are reconfiguring.

memory_full.message: There is not enough free memory on the lights for this. Delete movies you no longer need in the Twinkly app and try again.

too_many_movies.message: The lights hold as many movies as they can store. Delete a movie you no longer need in the Twinkly app and try again.

device_error.message: The Twinkly lights could not carry out the command: {error}

update_failed.message: Could not read the state of the Twinkly lights: {error}

invalid_color.message: Give exactly one colour: an RGB colour or a colour name.

core_twinkly_conflict.title: {name} is also set up with the built-in Twinkly integration
core_twinkly_conflict.description: The lights accept one login at a time, so Twinkly Canvas and Home Assistant's built-in Twinkly integration keep logging each other out of {name}. Remove the built-in Twinkly entry for these lights under Settings > Devices & services > Twinkly, then reload Twinkly Canvas.
